p06.title: Privacy notice
p06.lead: What ElectraGuard keeps, what it never collects, and what you can do. In plain words.

who.p: ElectraGuard AI is software made by Cairn. Observation organisations use it to collect and review reports about elections. The organisation that receives your report is responsible for it. ElectraGuard is nonpartisan and independent of INEC.

never.1: Your name. Citizens and observers do not give a name.
never.2: Your location from GPS. The app never reads it.
never.3: Your phone number in plain form. For SMS and USSD the number is kept only as a scrambled code, and the plain number is deleted once our reply is sent.

keep.1: What you report: what happened, where (no closer than the polling unit you choose), when, and what you wrote.
keep.2: Photos, videos and voice notes you add. Location data is removed from photos on your phone and again on our server. Faces we can detect are blurred.
keep.3: For observers: the observer code and a scrambled form of the PIN. Only the organisation knows who holds a code, and it keeps that list outside ElectraGuard.
keep.4: Basic security records, such as failed sign-in attempts, without the content of any report.

see.p: Only reviewers of the organisation that received it, and only when the report is given to them. Organisations cannot see each other's reports. Every time someone opens a photo or video, it is recorded.

public.p: Only totals of reviewed reports, by state, type and hour, published at least 60 minutes later. Any number below 5 is shown as "fewer than 5". Never your words, photos, polling unit, ward, receipt code or observer code.

ai.p: AI suggests a type and how urgent a report is, to help reviewers sort reports. It is always marked as a suggestion, and a person makes every decision. Ask ElectraGuard only quotes approved guides, and your questions are not stored.

speech.p: If you use Speak, your phone's speech service may process your voice to turn it into words. You can use your keyboard's voice typing, or type, instead.

rights.1: Withdraw a report before review starts. Its words and files are deleted.
rights.2: Check your report at any time with its receipt code.
rights.3: Clear a shared phone: observers can sign out and remove everything from the phone in one step.
rights.4: Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 you can ask the organisation that received your report to show, correct or delete information about you.

keepFor.p: Each organisation sets a period between 30 days and 2 years. After that, reports, files and messages are deleted, and backups expire on the same schedule.

security.p: Reports travel over encrypted connections and are stored encrypted. Staff use named accounts with two-step sign-in. Every change to a report is kept in a record that shows if anything was altered.

danger.p: Call 112. ElectraGuard records reports. It does not send help.

contact.p: For questions about your report, ask the organisation that gave you your observer code, or write to the reviewer in your report's messages.

p06.languages: This notice is in English, Naijá, Hausa, Yorùbá and Igbo. Choose a language at the top of the page.

p07.title: Try reporting by SMS and USSD
p07.lead: Use this on-screen phone to try ElectraGuard the way a basic phone does. It runs on the same system as real SMS and USSD.

ussd.wrongCode: That number does not answer. Dial {code}.

how.title: Try it
how.ussd: Dial {code} and press Call. Answer each menu with the keypad, then press Send.
how.report: Or write a message: REPORT, a category number, a polling unit code if you know it, then what happened.
how.reportExample: REPORT 3 Long queue and only one official checking names
how.status: Check a report: STATUS and the receipt code.
how.reply: Answer a reviewer's question: REPLY, the receipt code, then your answer.
how.lang: Change the language of replies: LANG EN, PCM, HA, YO or IG.

p07.simulated: Simulated number {number}. Reports sent from here are marked Simulated and never appear in public results.
p07.resetHint: Starts again with a different number and clears this screen.

error.network: No network. Check your connection and try again.
error.server: The phone service did not answer. Try again in a minute.
error.tooMany: Too many messages from this phone. Wait a few minutes.
error.invalid: The network refused that message. Check it and try again.

disabled.title: The phone simulator is switched off.
disabled.body: The observation organisation has turned it off for now. You can still report on this website.
